title: Follow the Road Transport Industry Termination Code before ending a contractor's contract
what: A road transport business considering ending a regulated road transport contractor's services contract must follow the Code's process and have regard to its mandatory considerations.

laws.title: Fair Work (Road Transport Industry Termination Code) Instrument 2024

sources.title: Fair Work (Road Transport Industry Termination Code) Instrument 2024
sources.quote: 10 Decision about termination of services contract Mandatory considerations in termination decision (1) In considering whether to terminate the services contract of a regulated road transport contractor after the show cause process in section 9 is complete, a road transport business must have regard to the following matters

sources.title: Fair Work (Road Transport Industry Termination Code) Instrument 2024
sources.quote: A regulated road transport contractor may be found to be unfairly terminated by a road transport business if the Fair Work Commission is satisfied that the termination is not consistent with this Code (see paragraph 536LK(d) of the Act).

sources.title: Fair Work Act 2009
sources.quote: 682 Functions of the Fair Work Ombudsman (1) The Fair Work Ombudsman has the following functions: (a) to promote: (i) harmonious, productive and cooperative workplace relations; and (ii) compliance with this Act and fair work instruments;
